name: cbt-chaos-preflight-worker
description: Short-lived CBT chaos team worker that validates one scenario run before any live execution: spec/trigger/cluster agreement, trigger script static checks, Krkn dry-run, cluster readiness, and destination PVC capacity headroom. Returns GO or NO-GO only; never mutates anything. Used when the Lead spawns the Preflight Worker with runs/<RUN_ID>/contracts/preflight.md.

name: cbt-chaos-recovery-worker
description: Short-lived CBT chaos team worker that runs the post-chaos same-VM recovery validation: new full/incremental backup on the recovered original VM with fresh object/PVC names, tracker/checkpoint checks, and restore verification. Acts only on Lead authorization per action, after PRESERVED. Used when the Lead spawns the Recovery Worker with runs/<RUN_ID>/contracts/recovery.md.

name: cbt-chaos-report-checker
description: Blind CBT chaos team checker that grades report fidelity: the two run reports must be standalone-readable, contain only observed facts, cite real evidence, and contain no harness internals, reconstructed commands, or expectations stated as facts. Returns PASS or REJECT (revision loop). Used when the Lead spawns the Report Fidelity Checker with runs/<RUN_ID>/contracts/check-report.md.

name: cbt-chaos-report-writer
description: Short-lived CBT chaos team worker that writes the two engineer-facing run reports (test-run-result.md, test-run-report.md) strictly from the closed evidence pack. Standalone, observed-facts-only, no harness internals. Used when the Lead spawns the Report Writer with runs/<RUN_ID>/contracts/report-writer.md after the verdict is assigned.

name: cbt-chaos-run
description: Run a KubeVirt CBT chaos scenario with product-focused full/incremental backup, checkpoint/tracker, CBT recovery, and restore verification. Validate scenario execution separately from the product result and report harness findings outside the standalone result/report. Supports v1 and CBT v2 scenarios; use when a user requests a scenario run or report.

name: cbt-chaos-run-analyst
description: Post-run CBT chaos team agent that analyzes one closed run: UTC timeline linking every stage, criterion-by-criterion table, product-vs-harness finding separation, and contradictions/confidence limits. Reads only the current run's closed artifacts. Analysis only — proposes nothing live. Used when the Lead spawns the Run Analyst after the run reaches closed.

name: cbt-chaos-scenario-improver
description: Post-run CBT chaos team agent that finds weaknesses in the test itself — spec, trigger, observer coverage, checker gaps, capacity planning — and proposes concrete diffs plus harness-ticket drafts. Trigger-script diffs are approved and applied by the Lead between runs; spec and SKILL.md diffs always require the human. Improves the scenario and harness, not the CBT product. Used when the Lead spawns the Scenario Improver after the run reaches closed.

name: cbt-chaos-simple
description: Execute one CBT chaos scenario simply and directly on the fixed execution host `ssh cloud05` (checkout /root/v2/virt-cbt-lab, kubeconfig /root/mno/kubeconfig — all make/oc/krknctl commands run there). Takes a scenario ID (e.g. CBT-F-08), reads its definition under cbt-chaos/scenarios_v2/<ID>/, plans the run, uses the krkn-scenario skill to derive and validate the krknctl command (or drafts an oc/kubectl fallback for faults krknctl cannot express), discusses the injection approach with the user, prechecks it, runs the make pipeline stage with the injector armed, validates the outcome through t…

name: cbt-chaos-team
description: Orchestrate a team of subagents for a CBT Chaos scenario run: one Lead agent that manages the run, plans and starts short-lived Workers, keeps the per-run state files, and reconciles the verdict; blind Checkers that independently pass or reject injection validity, evidence sufficiency, and report fidelity; and post-run Analyst/Improver agents that propose scenario, harness, and CBT-product improvements plus a bounded re-run matrix. Delegates the live run protocol (phases, safety, evidence rules) to the cbt-chaos-run skill; this skill adds the team topology, role contracts, and per-run state f…

name: cbt-chaos-team-v2
description: Dispatch one CBT chaos scenario to the dedicated Sol Lead subagent. Main relays human approval and clarification requests; Lead owns preparation, execution, independent grading coordination, reporting and verified closeout.

name: cbt-chaos-trigger-preparer-v2
description: Chaos Engineer for CBT chaos v2: author/revise the scenario bundle as a bundle-preparer, or complete one bounded prep/investigation/draft task as a task-specialist. Prefer native krknctl event triggers, then wrapped krknctl; use oc/kubectl only for faults krknctl cannot express, and only after explicit user consent. Never execute a disruption or grade your own work. Spawned by cbt-chaos-lead-v2; not user-invocable directly.

name: cbt-chaos-trigger-worker
description: Short-lived CBT chaos team worker that executes the verified chaos trigger for one run over SSH from the configured remote checkout, preserves separate workflow and action exit codes, and records the UTC action request with exact target identity. Gated on watch health at the injection boundary. Used when the Lead spawns the Trigger Worker with runs/<RUN_ID>/contracts/trigger.md.

name: cbt-chaos-variation-decider
description: Post-run CBT chaos team agent that decides whether to re-run the same scenario with different parameters and proposes the next bounded matrix leg: dimensions are backup mode (Full/Incremental), injection window position, storage backend, workload sizing, and OS. Proposes at most 4 legs per approved matrix, with hard stop conditions. Proposal only; the Lead executes and the human approves. Used when the Lead spawns the Variation Decider after the run reaches closed.

name: CBT-I四阶段结构化治疗协议
description: 一个标准化、时间限定的CBT-I（失眠认知行为疗法）宏观框架，按问题评估→行为干预→效果强化→巩固结束四阶段推进，每阶段有明确定义的目标、时长、核心任务与完成标志，支持4–6次咨询内系统实施。

name: CBT-I睡眠日记启动与结构化反馈循环
description: 在CBT-I治疗初期启动标准化睡眠日记作为客观行为评估工具，并在后续每次咨询中执行四步结构化复盘（完整性检查→指标计算→行为-体验链接→共识微调），形成‘记录-反馈-调适’临床闭环，强化治疗同盟与数据驱动决策。

name: cbt-scale-chaos
description: Scale-and-chaos harness for CBT backup testing on the fixed execution host `ssh cloud05` (checkout /root/v2/virt-cbt-lab, kubeconfig /root/mno/kubeconfig — all make/oc commands run there). Creates N parallel VMs (density pool), drives all-at-once full and incremental CBT backups with the parallel driver, provides a chaos-injection window mid-backup (delegating injection design to the cbt-chaos-simple skill), and verifies the fleet after backups complete: per-vmbackup Done-reason and tracker validation plus a Prometheus health sweep (error-rate spikes, controller restarts, storage latency, nod…

name: cbt-thought-record
description: Crée une fiche TCC pour examiner une pensée difficile, sans remplacer une psychothérapie. À utiliser pour ruminations, pensées automatiques, peur du jugement, culpabilité ou catastrophisme. Se déclenche aussi avec "je n'arrête pas de penser que…", "j'ai peur que…", "je me sens coupable", "et si tout allait mal", "je rumine", ou toute pensée négative répétitive. Also triggers on "CBT thought record", "challenge a negative thought", "cognitive distortions".

name: CBT-强迫症三阶段咨询协议
description: 一个结构化、分阶段的认知行为疗法干预流程，专用于强迫症伴抑郁状态来访者，含评估性会谈（1–2次）、咨询性会谈（3–6次）与巩固性会谈（7–8次）三阶段，每阶段有明确目标、技术焦点与成功标志。

name: CBT-系统脱敏三阶段协议
description: 一个跨会话的三阶段CBT干预框架，用于社交恐惧症：第一阶段建立关系与评估，第二阶段认知重构与暴露练习，第三阶段巩固与结束准备。适用于有明确社交回避行为、中等焦虑水平且愿意配合家庭作业的来访者。

name: cbtr-causality-topological-ranking
description: Causality-Based Topological Ranking (CBTR)

name: CBT三阶段咨询框架
description: 一个结构化、时间限定的CBT咨询流程，分为关系建立与评估、心理帮助、结束与巩固三个阶段，每阶段有明确目标、方法和产出。

name: CBT三阶段结构化咨询协议
description: 一个跨12次咨询的宏观CBT治疗流程框架，分为关系建立与评估（第1–2次）、认知行为干预（第3–10次）、巩固与预防复发（第11–12次）三个阶段，每阶段定义核心目标、关键任务、时长分配及协作要求，用于统筹标准化CBT疗程规划与跨专业协同。

name: CBT三阶段结构化咨询流程
description: 一个结构化、分阶段的CBT宏观框架，覆盖评估与关系建立、认知修通、巩固与泛化三个核心阶段，专为失恋等明确诱发事件引发的情绪困扰个案设计，支持多会话节奏控制与阶段目标锚定。

name: CBT三阶段结构化治疗流程
description: 将认知行为治疗划分为关系建立与个案概念化、自动思维识别与评估、核心信念识别与矫正三个递进阶段，每阶段有明确目标、典型时长范围、任务重点与可验证产出物，支持跨会话治疗节奏规划与协作性进程沟通。

name: CBT三阶段结构化治疗计划
description: 将CBT心理治疗划分为初期（建立联盟与个案概念化）、中期（认知矫正与行为激活）和后期（效果巩固与复发预防）三个阶段的跨-session 宏观流程框架，专为住院期重性抑郁障碍患者设计，强调与药物、工娱、物理及多学科躯体干预的时序协同。

name: CBT三阶段结构化辅导协议
description: 一个基于认知行为疗法的15次、分三阶段的结构化个体辅导宏观框架，明确各阶段目标、次数分配与核心任务。适用于需中程结构化干预的青少年情绪与人际问题。

name: CBT中间信念检视与更新工作流程
description: 运用苏格拉底式提问、成本-效益分析等技术，协助来访者检视其条件化假设（如'如果…就…'），发展更具适应性的中间信念，适用于情绪改善后需巩固认知弹性的情境。

name: CBT中间信念矫正工作表引导
description: 在CBT咨询第三阶段，当来访者已建立基本治疗联盟并识别出适应不良中间信念时，使用结构化工作表引导其通过苏格拉底式提问与现实检验完成信念重构。

name: CBT五栏表家庭作业引导
description: 结构化引导来访者在真实生活情境中完成五栏表（触发事件—自动思维—情绪/生理反应—支持与反驳证据—基于证据的替代思维），以建立元认知监控与认知重评能力；须嵌入苏格拉底式自我提问与微型行为试验设计，确保替代思维具实证基础与可操作性。

name: CBT五阶段结构化咨询流程
description: 将CBT咨询划分为五个递进阶段（关系建立与风险评估、创伤回溯、CBT原理教学与自动思维识别、支持系统建设与信念重构、自我悦纳与自信重塑），每阶段明确目标、时长与核心任务，嵌入学校系统协作节点（如专项心理帮扶基金、医院绿色通道），支持跨会话节奏控制与阶段跃迁。

name: CBT修通阶段三栏表+产婆术式辩论组合
description: 在生活事件语境中，协助来访者识别非黑即白、以偏概全、糟糕至极、无端否认、以己度人、管状视野等六类典型不合理思维，并用更理性、可观察、可验证、可行动的想法替代，从而调节情绪反应。

name: CBT六次结构化咨询流程
description: 一个标准化的6次CBT短期咨询框架，覆盖初始评估、自动思维干预、中间信念重构、核心信念探索、家庭系统觉察与结束巩固六个阶段。适用于轻中度情绪障碍青少年个案的学校心理咨询场景。

name: CBT六步结构化评估流程
description: 在CBT初始评估阶段，按六个固定步骤系统收集信息：问题界定、影响因素识别、目标澄清、基线数据采集、咨询同盟共建、方案制定。用于首次或阶段性再评估。

name: CBT初始会谈：个案概念化与治疗联盟建立
description: 在前1–2次CBT会谈中，系统完成发展性与系统性信息采集，通过心境检查与行为功能分析形成可操作的个案概念化，并与患者及家属共同澄清结构化设置、开展心理教育、共建SMART目标清单，从而确立稳固的治疗联盟。

name: CBT初始关系建立与评估双轨流程
description: 在第1–2次咨询中同步开展咨询关系建立（倾听、共情、无条件积极关注）与结构化诊断评估（开放性提问收集资料、鉴别诊断、衔接医生诊断），为后续CBT干预锚定方向。

name: CBT初始联盟建构三步法
description: 在认知行为治疗前3次咨询中，系统建立咨询联盟：共情接纳降低羞耻感、隐喻式心理教育增强信心、共同制定可操作目标。

name: CBT呼吸放松训练标准化脚本
description: 指导来访者执行4-1-6秒深慢呼吸（吸气4秒-屏息1秒-呼气6秒），配合身体扫描与意象引导，每日2次×5分钟，用于即时缓解恐惧相关的自主神经激活。

name: CBT咨询末期结构化回顾与强化
description: 在CBT咨询末期（第20–22次），系统回顾问题改善进程，将改变归因于来访者自身，并结合CBT原理反复强化认知行为改变机制；使用视觉化描述呈现波动性进展，建立对复发的现实预期。

name: CBT咨询末期结构化回顾与强化
description: 在CBT咨询末期（第20–22次），系统回顾来访者问题改善进程，将具体改变经验与CBT核心原理（如认知重构、行为实验、双重故事）联结；通过视觉化描述（如波动曲线）正常化进展中的停滞、反复与暂时性倒退；强调改变主因在于来访者自身能动性，并引导其内化并承诺持续使用已掌握的CBT工具。

name: CBT咨询终止阶段结构化回顾与成长确认
description: 在CBT咨询末期，系统回顾咨询过程、进展与来访者自我觉察提升，强化其对自身成长的确认，并为后续自主探索做准备。

name: CBT咨询结束期四段式整合回顾
description: 在最后一次CBT咨询中，以结构化、来访者中心的方式引导其自主复述问题起源、改变过程、当前状态与未来应用，强化认知行为策略的生活迁移意识，完成自然、有准备的咨询结束。

name: CBT四阶段咨询框架
description: 一个结构化的认知行为疗法宏观协议，将咨询划分为关系建立与概念化、认知重构、行为干预、效果巩固与结束四个递进阶段。适用于强迫症等焦虑相关障碍的系统性CBT干预。

name: CBT四阶段咨询结构化流程
description: 将CBT咨询划分为开始、认知重建、信念矫正与结束四个阶段的跨-session 宏观协议，规定各阶段目标、时长范围与核心任务。

name: CBT四阶段结构化咨询协议
description: 一个跨会话的、阶段化的CBT宏观治疗流程，包含心理诊断、领悟、修通与再教育四个递进阶段，用于系统性开展大学新生适应不良的短期认知行为干预。

name: CBT四阶段结构化咨询流程
description: 将CBT咨询划分为心理评估、关系建立与家庭关系梳理、不合理认知重构、人际关系泛化四个递进阶段，每阶段含目标、方法、过程和作业布置；阶段间以一周间隔为观察窗口，次数弹性（2–3次/阶段），依据家庭关系改善程度与认知调整进展动态调整。

name: CBT四阶段结构化治疗流程
description: 一个跨阶段、多会话的CBT治疗宏观框架，按问题理解→概念化与目标设定→认知行为干预→巩固与预防复发四阶段组织10次住院心理治疗。

name: CBT复发应对卡制作
description: 指导来访者制作个性化应对卡，明确写出咨询结束后若问题反复时的具体应对步骤、潜在阻碍识别及资源调用方式，强化其独立解决问题的能力与掌控感。

name: CBT复发预防与家庭协同巩固协议
description: 在治疗终期（第8–9次）结构化会谈中，同步开展个体技能巩固与家庭系统干预：引导患者归因进步、复习技术、建立自我效能；联合家庭成员强化情感联结、澄清出院担忧、学习运用CBT技术应对日常问题，并共同制定可操作的复发预警与响应计划。

name: CBT复发预防结构化收尾
description: 在咨询结束期（倒数2–3次），系统引导来访者结构化回顾CBT学习历程，将行为/情绪改善显性联结至认知重构与行为实验原理，协同共建具象化、可观察的个性化复发征兆信号清单，并分层制定三级应对策略（自我调节→支持系统启动→专业求助触发），最终锚定一项SMART原则校验通过的未来90天行动目标，以巩固疗效、增强自我管理能力、降低复发风险。

name: CBT家庭作业布置
description: 引导来访者识别不合理信念，按'更灵活、更现实、更具适应性'三原则共同构建可操作的合理信念，并书面记录。用于巩固认知重构效果，促进行为迁移。

name: CBT家庭作业布置与跟进
description: 在CBT咨询中，系统性布置并结构化跟进家庭作业，以促进认知重构与行为改变的泛化。适用于已建立工作联盟、完成初步评估、进入正式干预阶段的来访者。

name: CBT家庭作业结构化布置
description: 在咨询末尾，针对当次核心认知主题，布置具身化、可记录、可复盘的简明作业，聚焦‘觉察—记录—归因’三要素，为下一次认知工作提供实证素材。

name: CBT导向的复发预防应对卡制作
description: 指导来访者在咨询结束阶段制作个性化‘应对卡’，以结构化方式明确问题反复时的具体行动步骤、潜在阻碍识别及替代应对策略，从而具象化复发预期、降低不确定性焦虑，并锚定其已掌握的CBT能力资源。

name: CBT导向的焦虑状态初步评估协议
description: 在首次1–2次咨询中，整合共情、积极关注与结构化问题澄清，快速聚焦就业压力、失眠、忧虑等核心症状群，形成‘焦虑状态’工作诊断，为后续CBT干预提供靶点依据。

name: CBT导向的认知重构引导对话
description: 在建立基本信任后，聚焦识别并挑战学生持有的核心消极自动思维（如‘人生已经烂透了’），通过苏格拉底式提问、证据检验、认知扭曲命名与替代性想法生成等CBT技术，促使其检验思维真实性并发展更平衡、具实证基础的认知灵活性。

name: CBT导向的阶段性咨询方案制定协议
description: 在第二次咨询中，基于心理测验结果与日常观察，协同求助者共同制定含近期目标与远期目标的咨询计划，并明确以合理情绪疗法为主、系统脱敏与放松疗法为辅的方法组合。适用于已完成初评、需锚定干预方向且具备目标协商能力的个案。

name: CBT就业焦虑三阶段咨询框架
description: 一个结构化、时间限定的三阶段CBT干预流程，专用于大学生就业焦虑问题，覆盖认知重构、行为激活与巩固结束三个核心阶段。

name: CBT工具移交与泛化训练
description: 在咨询终止阶段，系统性地将CBT核心工具（三栏表、思维记录表、箭头向下技术、行为实验、双重故事）移交来访者，引导其识别适用情境，鼓励持续收集支持新信念（如‘我有我价值’‘我有能力’）的实证，并付诸行动，以实现技术自主迁移与日常泛化。

name: CBT巩固与防复发阶段结构化流程
description: 在咨询末期（第11–12次）系统开展效果巩固、技能迁移与复发预防的标准化会话流程，适用于已完成核心CBT干预且症状显著缓解的来访者。

name: CBT强迫症三阶段短程干预框架
description: 结构化8次CBT咨询流程，按评估性会谈→咨询性会谈→巩固性会谈三阶段推进，整合悬搁接地技术与认知行为策略，专用于强迫症伴轻度抑郁状态、具自省力与作业执行力的成年来访者。

name: CBT心境检查与认知三角心理教育
description: 在每次咨询起始进行心境评分与情绪命名，并同步引入认知三角模型（情境-想法-情绪-行为），作为心理教育锚点，帮助来访者建立对认知-情绪关联的元认知觉察。

name: CBT思维-情绪关系 psychoeducation
description: 向来访者简明解释认知行为疗法中事件、思维与情绪三者之间的因果关系，帮助其建立初步的元认知觉察框架。用于咨询初期建立治疗联盟和心理教育基础。

name: CBT技能归因与生活化迁移训练
description: 在咨询结束阶段，将来访者在咨询中习得并实践的CBT工具（如三栏表、箭头向下、双重故事）明确归因于其自身能动性与选择，并协同其识别72小时内可及的真实生活情境，设定微小、可验证的行为证据收集任务，以支持新核心信念（如‘我有我价值’‘我有能力’）的持续内化与行动化。

name: CBT放松训练：网络疑病相关自主神经调节
description: 在个案干预中段，针对网络疑病诱发的自主神经高唤醒状态，系统引导来访者习得并练习渐进式肌肉放松或腹式呼吸技术，并通过结构化家庭作业巩固技能；全程强调正常化、非评判觉察与个体化调适。

name: CBT暴露后恶性循环认知解构
description: 在单次现实暴露结束后，引导来访者识别并命名由回避行为维持的‘焦虑-厌恶-回避’自我强化循环，用具体事件链说明其如何阻断自然习惯化过程。

name: CBT核心信念四句锚定小结
description: 在单次CBT咨询结束阶段，以精炼、非说教、生活化方式陈述四句核心认知行为原理，用于强化概念内化、支持作业执行，并为后续干预建立共同理解框架。

name: CBT核心信念巩固性重述
description: 在巩固阶段，引导来访者用第一人称、现在时、肯定句式重述已修正的核心信念，强调接纳局限性与生活平衡价值，强化新认知的稳定性与自我归属感。

name: CBT核心信念探索与能力再评估工作流程
description: 通过回顾个人经历、行为实验与能力盘点，引导来访者接触并松动关于自我、他人、世界的深层核心信念，重点重建自我效能感，适用于咨询中后期寻求根本性认同转变的情境。

name: CBT核心信念温习微作业布置
description: 在CBT单次咨询结束阶段，向求助者布置每日5分钟温习本次共同构建的1–3条合理核心信念的家庭作业，以强化神经可塑性、促进信念内化与行为迁移；严格限定形式（默读/朗读/录音复听）、时长（固定5分钟）、频次（每日一次）、起始时间（当日即始），不附加反思或实验任务。

name: CBT核心信念矫正工作流程
description: 通过识别自动思维→追溯中间信念→挖掘核心信念→检验证据→发展替代性核心信念的标准化序列，系统性更新来访者关于自我、他人、世界的核心信念。适用于已建立稳定咨询关系、能耐受认知探索的情绪困扰来访者。

name: CBT核心信念识别与协同重构
description: 在咨询初期、信任关系已初步建立的前提下，运用CBT认知概念化框架识别求助者不合理核心信念，并通过苏格拉底式提问、证据检验与协作生成等方式，引导其发展更具现实性、适应性与弹性的替代信念。

name: CBT深呼吸放松训练
description: 引导来访者通过有节奏的深呼吸练习实现生理与心理同步放松，用于缓解急性焦虑、改善睡眠启动障碍。适用于咨询中或日常自我调节场景。

name: CBT渐进式意象放松引导
description: 在首次咨询中向来访者教授标准化渐进性放松训练步骤，指导其每日3分钟自主练习，并明确反馈要求，以快速缓解焦虑、改善睡眠及增强自我调节感。

name: CBT焦虑-羞愧情绪链识别微干预
description: 在第3–4次CBT咨询中，基于个案具体生理/行为线索（如手心出汗、回避检查），引导其即时识别羞愧、内疚、自责等特定情绪，并锚定其背后的自动化思维与中间信念，构建‘情境→情绪→思维→信念’的可命名、可复述的觉察链条。

name: CBT焦虑干预四阶段流程
description: 一个结构化、分阶段的CBT个案干预框架，适用于学习受挫引发的青少年焦虑问题，含评估、认知重构、行为练习与巩固四个阶段。

name: CBT现实暴露中的实时情绪锚定与反馈
description: 在可控现实暴露过程中，咨询师每3～5分钟主动询问来访者当前主观焦虑强度（0–10分），同步引导其觉察情绪峰值时刻的自动思维变化，并在暴露结束后即时联结情绪消退体验与认知修正（如‘所担心的事并未发生’），以强化情绪-认知联结学习。

name: CBT现实暴露任务分级与实施计划
description: 在认知行为疗法框架下，为焦虑相关人际情境设计等级化暴露任务，并协同来访者制定包含去灾难化、回避行为教育、目标设定三要素的暴露实施计划。

name: CBT社交恐惧症暴露练习结构化方案
description: 在认知行为疗法框架下，为社交恐怖症求助者设计并实施渐进式暴露练习的结构化会话流程，含情绪监控、情景分级、作业布置与反思要求。

name: CBT社交焦虑阶段性咨询框架
description: 一个结构化、分阶段的CBT咨询流程，覆盖从建立联盟、认知重构到行为暴露与复发预防的全过程，专用于社交焦虑障碍的系统干预。

name: CBT终期会谈结构化框架
description: 在认知行为疗法（CBT）第10次（终期）咨询中，系统性完成认知成果巩固、疗效评估、现实迁移预演与分离情绪处理的标准化会谈流程。

name: CBT结束阶段三重巩固协议
description: 在最后一次CBT咨询中同步执行三项核心任务：引导来访者回顾自身变化与已掌握的有效技术、协助处理分离焦虑、共同构建现实可行的复发预防策略，形成结构化、内化导向的闭环收尾。

name: CBT结束阶段再教育与技能泛化工作流程
description: 在CBT咨询末期，结构化回顾咨询历程，强化新习得的认知与行为技能，指导求助者将所学迁移至日常生活场景，尤其聚焦人际交往中的情绪调节与沟通技巧应用。

name: CBT结构化单次咨询流程
description: 在每次认知行为治疗会谈中，按固定顺序执行六个环节：当前状况与心境检查、与上次会谈的联结、议程设置、家庭作业回顾、议程议题讨论与新作业布置、阶段总结；确保会谈聚焦、高效且具教学性。

name: CBT考前焦虑三阶段咨询框架
description: 一个面向大学生考前焦虑的结构化CBT咨询流程，分为建立关系、心理帮扶（认知重构）、巩固应用三个阶段，每阶段有明确任务与方法指向，提供跨会话的阶段性CBT干预主干。

name: CBT考试焦虑三阶段咨询框架
description: 一个结构化、阶段化的认知行为疗法咨询流程，覆盖诊断评估与关系建立、心理帮助（含认知重构与放松训练）、结束与巩固三个核心阶段，适用于考试焦虑个案。

name: CBT考试焦虑三阶段咨询流程
description: 一个结构化、阶段化的认知行为疗法咨询流程，专用于医学生考试焦虑干预，覆盖关系建立与评估、认知重建与技能训练、效果巩固与结束三个阶段，共5次会谈。

name: CBT自动思维反驳话术模板
description: 提供一组结构化、可复用的自我反驳语句，用于挑战‘我不行’类核心负性自动思维，适用于咨询中引导来访者进行认知重构练习。

name: CBT自动思维识别与反应训练
description: 引导来访者使用标准认知工具识别并回应自动思维，以觉察功能不良认知和逻辑歪曲，从而减轻情绪症状。

name: CBT自动思维识别与苏格拉底式提问引导
description: 在认知行为疗法框架下，引导来访者识别特定情境中的负性自动思维，并通过结构化苏格拉底式提问促使其评估思维的真实性与适应性。适用于来访者已建立基本咨询关系、能报告具体情境与情绪反应时。

name: CBT自动思维识别与调整四步法
description: 在CBT会话中期干预阶段，引导来访者系统识别并挑战功能不良自动思维的结构化技术：①证据检验；②生成替代解释；③评估可能性（最坏/最好/最可能）；④自我同情提问。聚焦思维可塑性与认知弹性培养，强调协作性检验与来访者主动生成。

name: CBT自动思维识别与调整四步法
description: 在CBT框架下，使用结构化提问序列引导来访者从情绪出发，逐层挖掘自动化思维、中间信念与核心信念，实现认知内容的外化与层级标注。

name: CBT苏格拉底提问_不合理信念强度评估
description: 使用0–100%百分比量化技术，评估来访者对已明确定义的自动思维（如‘我很失败’）的主观确信度，作为认知重构的客观锚点；聚焦强度而非真假，要求整数输出与简要依据，闭环执行。

name: CBT行为实验设计与实施
description: 协同来访者设计可检验的假设性行为实验，用真实结果挑战适应不良信念，降低回避行为并提升情境自信。

name: CBT行为日志家庭作业布置与结构化反馈
description: 在首次咨询中标准化施测PHQ-9和GAD-7量表，向来访者解释结果含义，并据此形成初步工作评估，为CBT方案选择提供实证依据。

name: CBT认知修正引导框架
description: 一个聚焦于早期教育与意义重构的CBT会话支架，用于帮助来访者理解症状成因、识别自动化思维，并发展替代性叙述，尤其适用于道德颓废、罪恶感与羞耻相关困扰。

name: CBT认知偏差识别与重构引导
description: 在咨询中期阶段，引导来访者识别失恋和家庭关系中的不合理信念，并通过共同分析促发其认知调整动机。适用于来访者已建立基本咨访关系、情绪初步稳定、能配合叙述具体场景时。

name: CBT认知家庭作业结构化指派
description: 在来访者已理解ABC模型并完成至少一轮认知质辩后，指导其在生活情境中实践结构化认知重构：记录事件→识别自动思维→标注认知扭曲→生成合理替代想法→应用自我暗示，形成闭环练习。

name: CBT认知扭曲识别与面质
description: 在认知调整阶段，使用面质技术帮助来访者识别并挑战其'全或无'、'非黑即白'等极端化自动思维。适用于来访者已表达自我贬低（如'觉得自己是活该的'）且存在明显认知偏差时。

name: CBT认知概念化建模
description: 基于来访者信念与行为模式构建个体化认知概念化图，作为后续干预的理论锚点和治疗地图；用于每次咨询初始阶段或概念化修订时。

name: CBT认知行为干预阶段工作框架
description: 在心理咨询第3～8次中，系统性开展自动思维识别、正念觉察训练与行为激活三类核心干预，通过结构化家庭作业与会谈反馈形成闭环。适用于已建立基本咨访关系、情绪稳定性初步达标、有意愿配合结构化练习的来访者。

name: CBT认知重构双路径技术
description: 结合提问引导与自我审查两种互补策略：前者通过多角度提问揭示思维盲区，后者通过表达-体验-反省闭环促进不合理信念觉察与修正，聚焦舞台失误归因偏差。

name: CBT认知重构双路径技术
description: 一种短程认知干预模块，包含‘提问引导’（多角度提问促觉察不合理思维）与‘自我审查’（鼓励表达并反省自我看法）两个平行子路径，用于矫正舞台表现相关的错误归因与灾难化信念。

name: CBT认知重构四步工作法
description: 在心理帮助阶段（第2～5次）系统性地识别、检验、修正和巩固来访者错误认知的结构化会话级干预流程。适用于存在明显表层与核心错误观念、且情绪行为受其主导的来访者。

name: CBT认知重构引导流程
description: 在咨询中期阶段，通过分析来访者自我报告和测评结果，系统引导其识别并纠正与专业调剂相关的错误认知，促使其形成客观理性的现实评估。

name: CBT认知重构微干预：修正完美化投射认知偏差
description: 引导来访者识别、检验并替代关于偶像的绝对化、完美化自动思维，代之以基于努力、现实能力与具体领域的适应性信念；适用于来访者表达‘我永远比不上他’‘天生不如’等自我贬低式比较时。

name: CBT资源取向自我效能感激活技术
description: 在CBT咨询中段，系统引导个案回溯成长史中持续付出的努力与适应性应对策略，通过具象化叙事识别、命名并锚定其既有能力，削弱习得性无助认知，增强对生活的掌控感体验。

name: CBT适应性人际技能具身化辅导
description: 将抽象人际原则（如真诚、分享、不计较得失）转化为具体可操作的行为句式，通过 therapist 示范与来访者30秒内限时模拟，在低压力微情境中激活已有认知领悟，强化行为尝试动机与自我主张体验。

name: CBT阶段性认知-情绪-行为进展三方校验
description: 在咨询结束阶段，结构化核查抑郁情绪缓解、生活节律规律性、社会功能重建（如主动兼职）三项指标，结合来访者自述与咨询师观察，确认CBT干预已达临床稳定阈值，支持安全结案。

name: CBT非理性信念识别与辩论
description: 帮助来访者识别并修正对'威信'的单一化、极端化认知，通过多维度比较与自我评估，引导其建立更平衡、现实的自我评价框架。适用于来访者将威信等同于权威压制（如大吼大叫）并因此产生焦虑的情境。

name: CBT非理性信念识别与验证作业布置
description: 针对人际敏感类自动思维，引导来访者识别投射性认知偏差，布置行为实验性质的家庭作业以检验其真实性。

name: CBT非理性信念验证作业
description: 布置结构化家庭作业，引导求助者记录现实互动事件、自动思维及情绪反应，并设计简易验证行动（如主动询问、观察反证），用于检验投射性认知偏差。适用于已识别出具体非理性信念（如‘别人肯定不喜欢我’）且情绪稳定者。

name: CBT饼图时间分配评估
description: 使用视觉化饼图工具评估来访者在学习、社交、休息、娱乐等生活领域的时间投入占比，识别结构性失衡，激发对理想生活样态的具象化构想与渐进式调整动机。

name: CBT首次会谈：关系建立、结构化评估与目标协同设定
description: 在CBT取向的首次咨询中，通过共情锚定、结构化信息收集、问题归类与协作式目标生成，建立治疗联盟并确立1–3项具体、可测、分阶段的初步咨询目标。

name: cbu-dashboard
description: Скилл для автоматической загрузки банковской статистики с сайта Центрального банка Республики Узбекистан (cbu.uz) и построения интерактивного HTML-дашборда с анализом динамики показателей по всем коммерческим банкам. Используй этот скилл всякий раз, когда пользователь хочет: - скачать отчёты / статистику / данные с cbu.uz или ЦБУ или Центробанка Узбекистана - построить дашборд по банкам Узбекистана - проанализировать динамику показателей банков (активы, кредиты, капитал, депозиты) - найти банки с отрицательной динамикой или риском потери лицензии - обновить / пересобрать дашборд из уже скачан…

name: cbvalidation
description: Use this skill when validating user input in ColdBox/BoxLang using cbvalidation. name: cell-boundary-intersection-over-min-area-quantification
description: Use when segmentation was run on overlapping image patches and you need to quantify whether per-patch masks conflict at patch seams before merging them into final cell polygons.

name: cell-boundary-polygon-export
description: Use when a Sopa-processed SpatialData object (e.g. a tuto.zarr store) must be converted into Xenium Explorer input files — experiment.xenium, pyramidal .ome.tif image, cell boundary polygons, and cell category files — for visualization.

name: cell-by-bin-matrix-construction
description: Use when raw scATAC-seq fragment/BAM data must be converted into a snap-format cell-by-bin count matrix (e.g., at 5-kb resolution) as the starting feature representation for clustering or dimensionality reduction without population-level peak calling.

name: cell-by-cluster-enrichment-scoring
description: Use when an AnnData object has log-cpm normalised scRNA-seq data with tentative (ideally over-clustered) Leiden labels and you need per-cell enrichment scores against every cluster's marker signature to support significance-based cluster merging.

name: cell-by-feature-matrix-construction
description: Use when you have a per-cell sparse k-mer abundance matrix (from jellyfish counts) and a CKG look-up table (from simhash), and need a normalized cells-by-CKGs feature matrix for downstream cell type classification.

name: cell-by-peak-anndata-construction
description: Use when single-cell calling cards qbed insertions and called peaks (e.g., 902 Brd4 peaks from mouse cortex GSE148448) must be converted into a cell-by-peak count matrix for integration with Scanpy gene-expression AnnData.

name: cell-calling-method-benchmarking
description: Use when a raw unfiltered gene-by-barcode count matrix (mtx or h5) from droplet-based scRNA/snRNA-seq needs cell-calling, and multiple callers must be compared against ground-truth labels (HTO singlet/doublet or demuxlet genotypes).

name: Cell-Cell Communication Analysis (CellChat)
description: ✅ **Use when:** - You have an annotated scRNA-seq dataset (Seurat object with cell type labels) - You want to identify ligand-receptor interactions between cell types - You want to visualize communication networks (chord diagrams, bubble plots) - You want to find dominant sender/receiver cell populations - **Chains from** `scrnaseq-seurat-core-analysis` output (`seurat_processed.rds`)

name: cell-cell-communication
description: Infer ligand-receptor signaling between cell types from scRNA-seq (and spatial) data. TRIGGER when the user mentions CellChat, CellPhoneDB, LIANA, NicheNet, Squidpy, "ligand-receptor", "cell-cell communication", "CCC", "intercellular signaling", "macrophage-T-cell crosstalk", "M1/M2 signaling", or has annotated single-cell data and wants to know which cell types are talking to which.

name: cell-cell-communication
description: Infer ligand-receptor signaling networks from annotated single-cell RNA-seq data and produce publication-ready communication plots. Use when you have a Seurat object with cell type labels and want to map sender/receiver/mediator roles, pathway activity, or cell-cell interaction matrices.

name: cell-cell-communication-benchmarking
description: Use when comparing ligand-receptor scoring rules for cell-cell communication inference on scRNA-seq data and you need an apples-to-apples benchmark on the same interaction database, same input matrix, and same permutation/significance pipeline.

name: cell-cell-communication-inference-from-scrnaseq
description: Use when scRNA-seq data has cluster/cell-type annotations and the goal is to compute transcriptome-based communication scores between sender and receiver clusters and rank specific ligand-receptor pairs (e.g., checkpoints, chemokines).

name: cell-cell-communication-matrix-factorization
description: Use when you have scRNA-seq expression (genes x cells) plus cell labels and need species-agnostic cell-cell communication inference, especially when no curated L-R database exists for the species or condition-specific shared vs unique signals are of interest.

name: cell-cell-communication-method-benchmarking
description: Use when single-cell RNA-Seq data must be interrogated for ligand-receptor interactions with multiple CCC methods, or when per-method interaction scores need to be combined into a robust consensus ranking via LIANA.

name: cell-cell-communication-module-interpretation
description: Use when you have pre-computed ligand-receptor CCI predictions (e.g., from CellChat on a scRNA-seq dataset such as GSE72056 melanoma) and need to biologically interpret which interaction groups/signals characterize a specific sender or receiver cell type.

name: cell-cell-communication-network-analysis
description: Use when you have clustered scRNA-seq cell groups and need to infer significant ligand-receptor communication between them, quantify pathway-level signaling, identify dominant senders/receivers, and group coordinated outgoing/incoming patterns.

name: cell-cell-communication-network-inference
description: Use when single-cell-resolution spatial transcriptomics data (e.g., seqFISH+ mouse cortex, Seq-Scope mouse colon) with a gene expression matrix plus cell spatial coordinates and cell-type labels is available, and the goal is to estimate which neighboring cell types regulate HVG expression.

name: cell-cell-communication-score-computation
description: Use when you need to quantify communication potential between an input cell population and partner cell types from transcriptomic data, e.g. comparing outward signaling of CAF-S1 vs CAF-S4 or LPS-stimulated DCs against the Primary Cell Atlas.

name: cell-cell-distance-based-communication-analysis
description: Use when you have non-spatial scRNA-seq data plus a limited spatial measurement of a few genes, and need to infer cell-cell communication or the spatial distance/range of a signaling pathway (e.g. Wg ~100 µm, Dpp ~125 µm).

name: cell-cell-distance-inference-from-transport-plan
description: Use when you have a fitted SpaOTsc transport plan γ* (n cells × m spatial positions) plus a spatial position distance matrix, and you need a pairwise spatial cell-cell distance matrix for downstream signaling or clustering analyses.

name: cell-cell-interaction-expression-profiling
description: Use when you have developmental series scRNA-seq (e.g., GSE153164 corticogenesis) with inferred L-R pair expression-change values and need to group interactions by temporal activity to pinpoint key developmental time points.

name: cell-cell-interaction-label-aggregation
description: Use when training or benchmarking a supervised CCI inference model (e.g., DeepCCI's ResNet+GCN interaction model) and per-method significant-interaction calls must be merged into a single consensus label set for classification.

name: cell-cell-interaction-network-comparison
description: Use when validating AI-inferred single-cell data against a real-profiled ground-truth cohort: you have matched (semi-profiled vs real-profiled) single-cell datasets with shared cell-type annotations and need a quantitative fidelity metric for cell-cell interaction inference.

name: cell-cell-interaction-network-degree-analysis
description: Use when bulk transcriptome + survival data have been reduced to prognostic immune marker gene pairs (IMGPs) and you need to rank cell types by favorable vs unfavorable prognostic associations via network degree.

name: cell-cell-interaction-network-inference
description: Use when you have a scRNA-seq expression matrix, cell-type labels, and time-point annotations and need to infer which ligand-receptor interactions connect which sender/receiver cell types at a given time point.

name: cell-cell-interaction-risk-score-modeling
description: Use when bulk transcriptomes with matched survival data (e.g., TCGA SKCM06 plus GSE validation cohorts) are available and a prognostic model must aggregate interaction-linked marker gene pairs into one risk score.

name: cell-cell-signaling-perturbation-scoring
description: Use when comparing cell–cell signaling between two tissue systems (e.g., IFN-stimulated vs. control PBMCs from SeuratData 'ifnb') and you need to rank edges where ligand and receptor are both significantly perturbed, whether concordantly or discordantly.

name: cell-citation
description: Use to convert references to Cell Press author–date style — in-text "(Smith et al., 2021)", an alphabetical reference list by first author with full author lists, journal names spelled out. This is the OPPOSITE of Science's numbered-by-appearance style.

name: cell-classification-cross-tabulation
description: Use when two cell-level AML/tumor classification labels exist for the same barcodes (e.g., CNA-based CONICSmat clusters vs. SNV/expression-based genotype calls) and you must quantify how well one predicts the other.

name: cell-cluster-marker-transposon-identification
description: Use when you have a processed scRNA-Seq BAM file and need to find which TEs (at locus resolution) are differentially expressed markers of specific cell clusters, e.g. cancer vs normal cell types.

name: cell-clustering-ari-evaluation
description: Use when you have simulated or labeled scRNA-seq data with known cell-type labels and need to quantify how well a normalization/confounding-removal method (e.g., scPLS) preserves cluster structure via ARI.

name: cell-clustering-validation-with-marker-genes
description: Use when a scRNA-seq clustering result (e.g., from scSPARKL on a mixed-species sample like the Jurkat–293T mixture) must be checked against known marker genes and a ground-truth cell partition.

name: cell-collective-database-model-retrieval
description: Use when a refined GRN (adjacency matrix) must be converted into a draft Boolean Network and curated Boolean functions are available in the Cell Collective for the organism under study.

name: cell-communication
description: Workflow for ligand-receptor communication inference in single-cell or spatial data with sender-receiver summaries and cautious interpretation.

name: cell-communication
description: Cell-cell / ligand-receptor communication analysis for single-cell data using LIANA+ (recommended consensus default), CellPhoneDB, CellChat (R), and squidpy's ligrec. Use for inferring cell-cell communication, ligand-receptor pairs, source->target signaling from an annotated .h5ad. Trigger terms - "cell-cell communication", "ligand-receptor", "CellPhoneDB", "CellChat", "LIANA", "cell interaction", "ligrec".

name: cell-communication-gene-labeling
description: Use when an HVG list (e.g. from FindVariableFeatures(), variance, scannpy, or M3drop on seqFISH+/Seq-Scope data) must be split into communication-related (Y) vs non-related (N) genes via GeneCards/GO labels.

name: cell-communication-network-extraction
description: Use when you have a CPM-normalized single-cell expression matrix plus a cell-annotation metafile and want to predict which ligand–receptor pairs mediate communication between annotated cell types.

name: cell-communication-statistics-summary
description: Use when a single-cell atlas (e.g. Tabula Muris, ~117 cell types) has been processed with NATMI and you need organism-wide summary metrics of autocrine signalling, such as the median number of co-detected ligand–receptor pairs per cell type.

name: cell-composition-differential-testing-along-pseudotime
description: Decision support for detecting condition- or covariate-associated changes in cell abundance/density along a multi-sample scRNA-seq pseudotime trajectory (Lamian TCD/XCD testing).

name: cell-connectivity-estimation-from-single-cell-data
description: Use when you have a set of minimum spanning trees (one per Totem/CLARA clustering, constructed with Slingshot) and need per-cell connectivity values in [0,1] to rank clusterings and identify likely trajectory leaves and branch points.

name: cell-connectivity-profiling
description: Use when the input is a single-cell expression dataset (SingleCellExperiment) expected to follow a linear, bifurcating, or multifurcating tree trajectory, and you need to rank candidate clusterings and locate trajectory leaves and branch points without a prior clustering.

name: cell-connectivity-summary-edge-aggregation
description: Use when NATMI ExtractEdges.py output edges exist and the goal is to summarise the entire communication network to show how strongly or specifically each cell type communicates to every other cell type, identifying highly communicating cell-type pairs or communities.

name: cell-connectivity-vector-analysis
description: Use when a Totem analysis has produced many candidate CLARA clusterings and you must automatically pick which one(s) to feed into Slingshot MST construction based on cell connectivity.

name: cell-count-scaling-benchmark-analysis
description: Use when you must show how reconstruction accuracy and sensitivity of a scGRN method depend on the number of input cells, and ground-truth regulatory edges (e.g., SERGIO-simulated 100-gene modules) are available for scoring.

name: cell-count-subsampling-scalability-analysis
description: Use when you must quantify the runtime, memory, and clustering-performance scaling of an integration/clustering method across increasing numbers of cells and compare it with alternatives.

name: cell-count-summary-reporting
description: Use when a VDJ preprocessing or filtering step (e.g. setupVdjPseudobulk) has just been applied and you must quantify and report how many cells were retained versus input, as a baseline check before downstream pseudobulking or trajectory analysis.

name: cell-coverage-outlier-filtering
description: Use when a raw single-cell ChIP-seq/scATAC-seq count matrix (cells x bins/peaks/TSS regions) contains low-quality or extreme-coverage cells that must be filtered before PCA, t-SNE/UMAP, or clustering.

name: cell-crowding-visualization
description: Use when evaluating whether a low-dimensional embedding of small UMI count matrices suffers from cell crowding at the latent origin, comparing vMF spherical vs Euclidean VAE latents or t-SNE/UMAP/PHATE baselines.

name: cell-culture-basics
description: Mammalian cell culture fundamentals — aseptic technique, passaging, cryopreservation, and contamination control.

name: cell-culture-best-practices
description: Use when applying cell culture best practices.

name: cell-culture-fundamentals
description: Use when applying cell culture fundamentals.

name: cell-culture-implementation
description: Use when applying cell culture implementation.

name: cell-culture-tech
description: Expert cell culture technician with deep knowledge of aseptic technique, mammalian cell maintenance, passaging protocols, cryopreservation, and contamination troubleshooting. Specializes in HEK293, HeLa, CHO, and primary cells. Use when: cell-culture, aseptic-technique, cell-passaging, tissue-culture, mycoplasma-testing.

name: cell-culture-troubleshooting
description: Use when applying cell culture troubleshooting.

name: cell-curator
description: Annotate pre-clustered AnnData or MuData from local marker, ontology, reference, and multimodal evidence. Use for review-gated cell-type annotation, uncertainty assessment, parent-scoped refinement, and guarded write-back.

name: cell-cycle-age-distribution-modeling
description: Use when flow-cytometric single-cell data from an unsynchronized, exponentially growing culture must be placed on real cell-cycle time, and no time-resolved sampling exists to calibrate pseudotime directly.

name: cell-cycle-analysis
description: Cell cycle phase scoring and visualization for single-cell expression data. Uses Scanpy's score_genes_cell_cycle with Tirosh et al. 2015 S/G2M gene lists on any normalized AnnData (ThreePrimeUntargeted via Loader, scRNA-seq-like, or AnnData from CSV/parquet count matrix). Regressing out cell cycle effects for downstream analysis. Use when the user asks about cell cycle, proliferation, S phase, G2M, or cell state.

name: cell-cycle-effect-removal
description: Decision support for removing cell-cycle effects from single-cell RNA-seq expression matrices when an annotated set of cell-cycle control genes is available and downstream analyses require corrected expression.

name: cell-cycle-effect-removal
description: Use when a scRNA-Seq expression matrix (log-scaled, gene-by-gene centered) shows within-cell-type heterogeneity driven by annotated cell-cycle genes that obscures clustering of cell types or substructure, and a known cell-cycle gene set can be retrieved.

name: cell-cycle-effect-removal-method-benchmarking
description: Use when scRNA-seq data contain cell-cycle effects confounding subclone or subpopulation delineation, and the goal is to quantify which correction approach (circular vs linear) maximizes subclone separability.

name: cell-cycle-gene-annotation-mapping
description: Use when preparing a gene-by-cell expression matrix for ccRemover: gene names must be mapped to human ('human') or mouse ('mouse') cell-cycle annotations to build the if_cc indicator vector before running ccRemover.

name: cell-cycle-gene-list-curation
description: Use when preparing DeepCycle inputs: you need an organism-specific cell-cycle gene list, a base cycling gene (Nusap1 for mESCs, MELK for human fibroblasts), and expression/filter thresholds for gene inclusion.

name: cell-cycle-gene-phase-annotation
description: Use when single cells have been reordered along a differentiation trajectory (pseudo-temporal position) and you must cluster gene expression dynamics into temporal waves and check whether cell-cycle gene sets (mitosis vs DNA synthesis) fall into distinct, out-of-phase clusters.

name: cell-cycle-gene-regression-preprocessing
description: Use when applying UniTVelo to a pancreas AnnData with spliced/unspliced counts where a known subtle fate transition (e.g., Fev+ to Delta) must be recovered both with and without cell-cycle gene regression, to match a reference fate-mapping result.

name: cell-cycle-gene-set-factor-analysis
description: Use when labeled (Hoechst or equivalent) scRNA-seq or qPCR single-cell data are available and the goal is to quantify how accurately different cell-cycle characterization methods recover cell-cycle phase labels.

name: cell-cycle-geneset-enrichment-interpretation
description: Use when you need to show that periodic genes discovered ab initio from a circular manifold (Cyclum pseudo-time) are more enriched for GO:0007049 cell-cycle terms than genes ranked by principal components on scRNA-seq data.

name: cell-cycle-marker-expression-analysis
description: Use when a velocity-informed circular trajectory (e.g., Cytopath on the U2OS SMART-Seq2 cell cycle dataset) has been inferred and G1-phase cells must be split into early vs late stages and validated with marker expression tests.

name: cell-cycle-nicotine-target-nomination
description: Use when comparing a treated vs. control single-cell RNA-seq dataset (e.g., 10X Chromium hESC, ~12,280 cells) to find genes whose periodic/circular expression kinetics change between conditions.

name: cell-cycle-phase-binning
description: Use when h5ad data carry a continuous DeepCycle phase annotation (adata.obs['cell_cycle_theta']) with Ms/Mu layers, and you need to quantify how per-cell RNA content (total UMIs) changes around the cell cycle or locate phase transitions.

name: cell-cycle-phase-classification
description: Use when a processed Seurat object or count matrix from single-cell/spatial RNA-seq needs per-cell cell cycle phase assignment (G0, G1, S, G2M), e.g. to quantify quiescent fractions alongside accordion() cell type annotation.

name: cell-cycle-phase-classification-svm
description: Use when you have single-cell imaging (4i) or single-cell RNA-seq data with a top-k ranked feature subset and ground-truth cell cycle phase labels, and need an accuracy-based comparison of feature selection methods.

name: cell-cycle-phase-correlation-analysis
description: Use when scRNA-seq data exhibit dominant cell cycling at the onset of differentiation and you need to check whether RNA velocity-based simulation trajectories recapitulate cell cycle stages.

name: cell-cycle-phase-inference-deep-learning
description: Use when scRNA-seq data contains spliced/unspliced layers, cells are proliferating, and a continuous cell cycle phase assignment is needed from RNA velocity dynamics rather than gene-marker scoring.

name: cell-cycle-phase-scoring-tricycle
description: Use when you need to evaluate whether forecast or observed single-cell transcriptomic states recapitulate cell-cycle progression, by mapping cells (genes x cells matrices, e.g. scEU-seq hTERT RPE data) to tricycle phase positions.

name: cell-cycle-phase-transition-estimation
description: Use when an h5ad annotated by DeepCycle (with obs['cell_cycle_theta'] and scVelo Ms/Mu layers) needs cell-cycle phase labels and per-phase cell fractions, e.g. to validate inferred thetas against flow-cytometry proportions.

name: cell-cycle-pseudo-time-inference
description: Use when scRNA-seq gene expression is expected to follow a periodic process (e.g., cell cycle) and you need ab initio per-cell pseudo-time or phase ordering without prior marker-gene lists.

name: cell-cycle-pseudo-time-reconstruction
description: Use when given an unsynchronized scRNA-seq expression matrix (log2 TPM+1) and the goal is to recover cell cycle ordering (G1, S, G2/M) or compare pseudo-time methods such as SCUBA, Monocle, TSCAN, Wishbone, or DPT.

name: cell-cycle-pseudotime-evaluation
description: Use when evaluating an ordering/pseudo-time method for cyclic single-cell data against known stage labels (e.g., G1/S/G2/M), by sweeping cluster number k and comparing correlation-score curves between a proposed method and baselines.

name: cell-cycle-score-clustering
description: Use when a single-cell RNA-seq dataset may contain quiescent G0-like cells that confound pseudotime reconstruction, and cell-cycle scores (e.g. reCAT mean scores) are available to identify and remove them.

name: cell-cycle-scoring-single-cell
description: Use when a projected single-cell query contains predicted cycling cells (e.g. Mki67+ exhausted T cells) that need to be quantified and visualized against the projected cell-state labels.

name: cell-cycle-stage-comparison
description: Use when you have single-cell Hi-C contact matrices resolved by cell-cycle stage and need to test whether nested TLD hierarchy (modularity, TLD-adjR2, weighted similarity WS) changes across stages such as G1 vs S phase vs G2.

name: cell-subpopulation-identification-in-2d-embedding
description: Use when scRNA-seq data contain known or suspected heterogeneous cell populations (e.g., developmental stages E3–E7 or lineage compartments like ICM/PE/EPI vs TE) that should be recovered as separable clusters in a low-dimensional 2D visualization.

name: cell-subsampling-and-label-shuffling
description: Use when you need to test how sensitive CCC inference methods (CellChat, CellPhoneDB, Connectome, NATMI, SingleCellSignalR, iTALK, Cytotalk via LIANA) are to cell-level noise—reduced cell numbers or erroneous cell-type annotation—in a scRNA-seq dataset.

name: cell-subset-filtering-by-reference-annotation

name: cell-subset-resampling-across-patients

name: cell-subtype-fine-annotation-with-template-classifiers

name: cell-subtype-supervised-classification

name: cell-summary

name: cell-type-abundance-thresholding

name: cell-type-aggregate-score-verification

name: cell-type-aggregation-of-per-cell-scores

name: cell-type-agnostic-feature-computation

description: Use when a large cell-type-annotated scRNA-seq reference (.h5ad) must be reduced to a representative sketch to serve as the reference matrix for deconvolution of pseudobulk/bulk RNA-seq samples, and sketch quality must be judged by proportion-estimate accuracy.

name: cell-type-annotation
description: Generate code to assign cell type labels to single-cell RNA-seq clusters using CellTypist, SingleR, marker-based annotation, or reference label transfer (scANVI/ingest). name: cell-type-annotation-accuracy-evaluation
description: Use when a trained cell-type annotation model (e.g. a DNN on .h5ad scRNA-seq data) must be scored against ground-truth labels on a held-out test set, or when comparing annotation tools for accuracy and run feasibility on large datasets (>0.6M cells).

name: cell-type-annotation-accuracy-validation
description: Use when GeneVector phenotype_probability annotations must be trusted before downstream analyses like latent-space arithmetic; trigger when an independent label source (e.g., CellAssign) exists for concordance checking.

name: cell-type-annotation-benchmarking

name: cell-type-annotation-by-gsea
description: Use when you have Seurat cluster marker lists (only.pos=TRUE, min.pct=0.25, logfc.threshold=0.25) from scRNA-seq data and need automated, database-backed cell-type annotation for each cluster.

name: cell-type-annotation-from-marker-genes
description: Use when scRNA-seq cluster assignments produced by an unsupervised method (e.g. scBGEDA) lack cell-type labels and a curated marker database such as CellMark can be matched against per-cluster DEGs.

name: cell-type-annotation-from-signature-scores
description: Use when a normalized scRNA-seq object (e.g., SingCellaR Human_HSPC) needs cell-type labels from lineage signature gene sets rather than marker-gene inspection or reference mapping.

name: cell-type-annotation-mapping
description: Use when you have a rooted lineage tree in Newick plus per-cell cell-type labels and want to quantify which cell types co-occur within subtrees (e.g., after cutting the LinRace embryo tree at depth 26).

name: cell-type-annotation-mapping
description: Use when a single-cell expression matrix (genes x cells) must be paired with a cell-annotation metafile before running NATMI ExtractEdges.py, or when cell-type labels need to be validated so edges are attributed to the right cell types.

name: cell-type-annotation-marker-genes
description: Use when you have a cell-by-factor or low-dimensional embedding from paired multi-omics data (e.g., Mowgli on TEA-seq PBMC) and need per-cell type labels grounded in canonical gene/protein markers plus an independent reference annotation.

name: cell-type-annotation-model-evaluation
description: Use when benchmarking a cell type annotation tool's accuracy on reference-to-query label transfer, or when assessing whether annotation performance depends on expert-knowledge masks vs. parameter-matched random masks.

name: cell-type-annotation-model-training
description: Use when confident cell type labels from a consensus of annotation tools must be spread to unlabeled cells in scRNA-seq data via a graph convolutional network, or when tuning GCN hyperparameters per dataset.

name: cell-type-annotation-model-training
description: Use when benchmarking how subsampling/sketching (e.g. scValue sketches at 0.02–0.10 fractions) affects supervised cell-type annotation accuracy on .h5ad scRNA-seq datasets with known ground-truth labels.

name: cell-type-annotation-pipeline-comparison-benchmarking
description: Use when you must quantify resource/accuracy trade-offs of cell type annotation pipelines on identical feature subsets of an scRNA-seq dataset (e.g., reproducing a Table-3-style comparison of accuracy, memory, and execution time).

name: cell-type-annotation-plotting
description: Use when comparing imputed vs. unimputed scRNA-seq matrices (e.g., Jurkat-293T or Zeisel datasets) to assess whether imputation improves clustering of annotated cell-type subpopulations, as in Fig. 5 of the AutoImpute paper.

name: cell-type-annotation-scoring-against-reference-database
description: Use when scRNA-seq clusters (e.g., from Seurat) need automatic, knowledge-free cell type annotation by scoring cluster marker genes against a tissue-specific cell taxonomy reference database rather than manual marker inspection.

name: cell-type-annotation-standardization
description: Use when combining scRNA-seq studies whose free-text cell annotations differ, e.g. before rendering a cross-study comparison of expression across aligned cell types in Cellenium (H5AD-imported studies with ontologized metadata).

name: cell-type-annotation-transfer-with-mlp-classifier
description: Use when semi-profiled single-cell data (e.g. scSemiProfiler output for a COVID-19 cohort with Healthy/Asymptomatic/Mild/Moderate/Severe/Critical conditions) is unlabeled, and annotated representative single-cell reference data exists to train a classifier for label transfer.

name: cell-type-annotation-visualization
description: Reference for annotating scywalker long-read single-nuclei per-cell gene counts with cell types from a markerset and visualizing the assignments on UMAP in the QC report.

name: cell-type-bootstrap-association-testing

name: cell-type-classification-accuracy-computation
description: Use when benchmarking supervised cell-type classifiers on annotated scRNA-seq data and you need repeatable accuracy and balanced-accuracy estimates for SciBet, scmap, and Seurat v3 across many datasets.

name: cell-type-classification-evaluation
description: Use when a labeled single-cell RNA-seq AnnData (cell x gene, 'class_label' column) needs automated cell-type label transfer with measurable accuracy/F1, including imbalanced, many-class (e.g., 42-type mouse brain) or small-training-set settings.

name: cell-type-classification-evaluation

name: cell-type-classification-macro-f1-evaluation
description: Use when comparing cell type annotation models on a held-out test set and you need donor-generalizing performance metrics such as macro F1-score and cross-entropy loss.

name: cell-type-classification-performance-evaluation

name: cell-type-clustering-assessment

name: cell-type-composition-regression-analysis

name: cell-type-marker-enrichment-annotation

name: cell-type-marker-enrichment-interpretation

name: cell-type-marker-gene-selection

name: cell-type-marker-gene-validation
description: Use when scBridge (or a baseline such as scJoint, Seurat or GLUE) has produced predicted cell-type labels on target scATAC/ADT data and you need marker-based evidence that the predicted populations (e.g. Naive vs Effector CD4+ T cells) are biologically correct.

name: cell-type-marker-gmv-inference

name: cell-type-matching-metric-evaluation

name: cell-type-prediction-confusion-matrix-computation

name: cell-type-proportion-controlled-synthetic-data-generation

name: cell-type-specific-co-expression-inference

Use whenever Tower records are created or updated by code rather than by importing…

name: cetmix-tower-automation
description: Trigger Cetmix Tower work without a human click — scheduled_task records for interval-based runs of commands or flight plans on servers and jets, webhook and webhook_authenticator records for inbound HTTP triggers with their result contracts and IP allowlists, and git_project / git_source / git_remote for repository definitions. Use when something must run on a schedule, be triggered by an external system, or track git sources.

name: cetmix-tower-command-actions
description: Choose and wire the right Cetmix Tower command action, and author the orchestration actions in depth — plan, jet_action, create_waypoint, file_using_template, and git_project_upload. Covers required companion fields, execution semantics, exit codes and the flight-plan-only restriction. Use when a command must orchestrate something rather than run a shell statement or Python.

name: cetmix-tower-command-python
description: Write Cetmix Tower Python commands (command records with action python_code) — the safe_eval sandbox, the result dict with exit_code and message, injected objects (env, server, jet, jet_template, waypoint, tower, custom_values), available libraries, pythonic variable rendering, secrets, metadata, calling provider APIs with requests, and the safe_eval restrictions that break normal Python. Use when a Tower command must run inside Odoo rather than on a host.

name: cetmix-tower-command-ssh
description: Write Cetmix Tower SSH commands (command records with action ssh_command) — the one-statement rule, why never to use &&, ; , cd or inline sudo, how to use the path and use_sudo fields instead, idempotency, OS scoping, variables and secrets inside shell code, preferring docker create --env over a host file (hard rule 18), and server_status side effects. Use when authoring or reviewing any shell-side Tower command.

name: cetmix-tower-files
description: Manage remote files with Cetmix Tower — file_template and file records, tower vs server source, text vs binary, server_dir and file_name with variables, rendering content with variables and secrets, the file_using_template command action with if_file_exists and disconnect_file, auto sync, and using files as server logs. Prefer process env over a host file (hard rule 18); use a file template only when env cannot express the format. Use whenever a configuration file, script or log has to be pushed to or fetched from a host.

name: cetmix-tower-flight-plan
description: Design Cetmix Tower Flight Plans (plan, plan_line, plan_line_action records) — line sequencing, Python conditions, use_sudo and path overrides, post-run actions and exit-code branching, on_error_action, setting variable values from a line, composing sub-plans with action plan, and where plans attach (servers, jet actions, waypoints, shortcuts, scheduled tasks). Use when building or reviewing any multi-step Tower execution flow.

name: cetmix-tower-jets
description: Build Cetmix Tower Jet Templates — jet_template, jet_state and jet_action records, the Prepare/Build/Start/Stop/Restart/Remove/Destroy lifecycle, the required state_transit_id, create and destroy actions, why Build and Start must use different plans, template dependencies, install/uninstall/clone plans, limit_per_server, deletable, server logs for control and maintenance, and atomized vs monolithic design. Use whenever deploying a managed application instance rather than running a one-off flight plan.

name: cetmix-tower-secrets
description: Handle sensitive data in Cetmix Tower — key records of type Secret and SSH Key, generating an SSH key pair in Tower (from the form, the API or a flight plan), the inline reference syntax

name: cetmix-tower-servers
description: Define Cetmix Tower hosts and their supporting records — server and server_template (SSH settings, use_sudo, variables, required values, creation and deletion plans), server_log for log views, shortcut for one-click actions, os for OS scoping, and tag for classification. Use when provisioning servers, building a server template, or adding logs and shortcuts to a host.

name: cetmix-tower-variables
description: Model Cetmix Tower configuration with variables — variable, variable_option and variable_value records, the Jet to Jet Template to Server to Global resolution order, global vs scoped values, String vs Options types, validation patterns, value modifiers, generic vs pythonic rendering, the tower.server / tower.jet / tower.tools system variables, custom_values, and when to use metadata instead. Use when deciding what should be configurable or when writing variable YAML.

name: cetmix-tower-waypoints
description: Add snapshot and backup capability to Cetmix Tower Jets with waypoints — jet_waypoint_template records and their create/arrive/leave/delete flight plans, the waypoint state machine, saving and restoring variable values, waypoint metadata and the __waypoint_* custom variables, and the create_waypoint command action. Use when a Jet needs backups, restore points or the ability to switch between saved configurations.

name: cetmix-tower-yaml
description: Write, review or fix Cetmix Tower YAML — the import/export format for Tower records. Covers file structure (cetmix_tower_yaml_version / manifest / records), the cetmix_tower_model names, relational field syntax (_id vs _ids, reference vs exploded), which child models must be nested, record ordering, the import wizard procedure and conflict handling, plus the authoritative per-model allowed-field lists. Use whenever producing or debugging a .yaml file for Cetmix Tower.

description: 何时调用：当用户需要理解不讲情面揭发错误加完全为了救人的建设性纠偏方法时。 关键信号："怎么惩前毖后治病救人？"、"不讲情面揭发错误完全为了救人？"、"建设性纠偏？"。 何时不调用：用户需要的是两类矛盾（用 lianglei-maodun），或用户需要的是组织纠偏诊断（用 zuzhi-jiupian-zhenduan）。

name: chengqianbihou-zhibing-jiuren
description: 不讲情面揭发错误 + 完全为了救人的建设性纠偏方法。当用户需要处理团队成员的严重错误但又不忍心处罚时激活。 不调用场景：对方恶意破坏且不可转化的场景（用两类矛盾skill中的对抗性处理）、小事不需要严肃纠偏。 来源：《毛泽东选集第1-5卷》毛泽东

name: chengxin
description: 同程程心 Skill - 基于同程旅行大模型（程心）的在线旅游搜索能力。提供更专业的机票、火车票、酒店、度假产品（自由行/跟团游）、旅游攻略、行程规划、特价机票、汽车票、长途汽车、景区、门票等的查询能力，基于同程官方数据，更加实时准确可靠，一键进入预订页面，让旅行更简单，更快乐。

name: chengxing-conflict
description: Use when a user wants to analyze a recurring interpersonal conflict, pause escalation, express a boundary, repair a safe relationship, or turn rumination into action. This Codex compatibility adapter routes requests to the independent Chengxing OS conflict-reset plugin and stops ordinary dialogue in violence, coercion, or stalking scenarios.

name: chengxing-habit
description: Use when an adult wants to change a recurring low-risk personal behavior such as procrastination, bedtime phone use, delayed sleep routines, exercise avoidance, or habit relapse. This Codex compatibility adapter routes natural-language requests to the independent Chengxing OS habit-rebuild plugin and its B1/B2/B3 workflow.

name: chengxing-parent
description: Use when a parent or caregiver needs help with homework start, repeated prompting, family learning routines, phone boundaries, or parent-child learning conflict. This Codex compatibility adapter routes natural-language requests to the independent Chengxing OS parent-learning plugin with child, parent, and environment actions.

name: chengyu-adapt-to-changing-circumstances
description: Use when the original plan needs to flex mid-flight in response to new information / changed inputs / discovered constraints — but flexibility WITHOUT defined scope degenerates into either rigid plan-sticking or unbounded winging-it. CRITICAL Step 0 (mirror of chengyu-close-door-catch-thief): scope MUST be defined before any deviation. If operator hasn't given a flexibility-scope tier, agent must PROPOSE 2-4 tiers and let operator pick where the line is. Default tier is "don't do irreversible damage to hardware, software, and data" but context shifts the boundary (hackathon, prod deploy, code…

name: chengyu-besiege-wei-save-zhao
description: Use when the operator has explicitly authorised an indirect / non-causal move — when frontal attack is blocked AND chengyu-remove-firewood-from-cauldron has been exhausted, requiring attention-redirect or incentive-shift rather than technical root-fixing. Default to chengyu-remove-firewood-from-cauldron unless the operator has told the agent how to 圍魏.

name: chengyu-borrow-corpse-return-soul
description: Use when proven-elsewhere logic should be transplanted into your project rather than re-derived — covers both reviving abandoned-but-good code from your own history AND copying live working config (linting, CI, README templates, infra patterns) from a healthy sibling project. The "soul" is the working logic; the "body" is your project that receives it.

name: chengyu-break-whole-into-parts
description: Use when facing a task too large to hold in one piece — decompose into atomic subtasks. Divide-and-conquer in chengyu form. Pairs naturally with subagent dispatch (each part becomes one subagent's job) and with the dispatching-parallel-agents superpower. The decomposition itself is the skill — the parts should each have one clear purpose and a well-defined interface to the others.

name: chengyu-cicada-sheds-its-shell
description: Use when designing a migration — graceful transition where the old interface stays as a thin stub/proxy/shim, real implementation moves underneath, consumers keep working through the transition, eventual cleanup of the shell once consumer count reaches zero. The schema of every good rename / endpoint move / library v1→v2 / database schema migration / monorepo split.

name: chengyu-cleave-ox-at-joints
description: Use when planning any non-trivial change — refactor, bug fix, migration, optimisation, communication — and the agent should find the natural seams / high-leverage points of the target system rather than brute-forcing through. Cut at joints (low resistance, clean result), not at bone (high resistance, blade dulls, messy result). The patron-saint chengyu of working WITH the grain of the system.

name: chengyu-close-door-catch-thief
description: Use when debugging by narrowing the search space — isolate the failure domain so the bug reproduces in a controlled, minimal environment. CRITICAL Step 0: the agent must ASK (if unclear) or PITCH (if obvious, just needs operator confirmation) the specific "close the door" strategy BEFORE executing it; the closing has side effects (disabling services, modifying shared state, replacing real integrations with mocks) that need operator sign-off.

name: chengyu-create-something-from-nothing
description: SUBAGENT-ONLY skill for generating a graduated spread of plausible-to-speculative solutions when the main agent is stuck in a local minimum. Output is one continuous artifact (NO dividers) that starts from verified fact and slides into bottom-K speculation; calling main-agent fact-checks throughout. Has TWO HARD PRECONDITIONS that must be met before any output: (1) running on a BullshitBench-passing model (Claude Opus 4.5–4.8 / Sonnet 4.5–4.6, or equivalent — NOT the Claude 5 generation), (2) operator — NOT the agent — explicitly confirms for this invocation that the running model qualifies.…

name: chengyu-great-wisdom-looks-foolish
description: Use when resisting the urge to demonstrate cleverness — obvious-and-simple is often the right answer, and performative complexity is the failure mode. REQUIRES a target parameter at invocation specifying which dimension to apply to — implementation (over-engineered code), representation (over-fancy reply / unnecessary verbosity), or both. The agent must ASK for the target if the operator hasn't specified.

name: chengyu-grind-pestle-to-needle
description: Use when working on a hard problem where most attempts fail — when 99 of 100 things won't work and the temptation is to give up before the 100th; when each failed attempt's value (it ruled something out) is being underweighted; when incremental compound progress on an unsharpened-needle target is needed

name: chengyu-know-what-you-dont-know
description: Use when about to guesstimate over a gap in knowledge — surface the gap explicitly instead. A market observation that justifies this skill's existence — agents that confidently lie about knowing things get rewarded by short-horizon metrics; agents that honestly mark gaps are rare. Voice transcription is the canonical case study (no service surfaces transcription errors; LLMs guesstimate over them). This skill's whole shape is "be the rare agent that says 'I don't know X' instead of fabricating a smooth answer".

name: chengyu-listen-all-sides-see-clearly
description: Use BEFORE declaring victory / shipping / committing, AND proactively for any non-trivial claim, answer, plan, or decision that would benefit from fresh external input — default to invoking it for substantive work rather than waiting to be asked, since bringing fresh info into the conversation is generally worth the token cost. Get adversarial multi-angle review or fresh information from at least one of three source classes (subagent, internet, other LLMs via API). Inter-links with chengyu-create-something-from-nothing — high-hallucination LLM sources behave like uncontrolled 無中生有, so apply t…

name: chengyu-lost-sheep-repair-fence
description: Use after a failure has occurred (bug shipped, test broke, deploy rolled back, data lost, security incident) — the impulse is to fix the immediate damage and move on, but the chengyu's discipline is to ALSO fix the cause so it doesn't repeat. Pairs with chengyu-remove-firewood-from-cauldron on the timing dimension — 釜底 is pre-symptom prevention, 亡羊 is post-symptom fortification.

name: chengyu-one-time-one-meeting
description: Use when tempted to treat the current session as interchangeable with past or future ones — the every-session-is-unique discipline, and the invocation surface that fires durable-fix skills a fungible-session mindset would skip. Fires when about to defer something to "a future session" as if that session will reconstitute this exact context, when a memory-aware agent assumes "I'll just re-derive it from memory next time," or when about to take the cheap reversible-looking shortcut (leave a comment instead of a stub, a TODO instead of the fix, skip the memory write) on the assumption the work i…

name: chengyu-remove-firewood-from-cauldron
description: Use when a symptom has an OBVIOUS causal root and the temptation is to patch the symptom — when a bug fix is masking the real issue, when retries are hiding a contract violation, when a workaround is becoming permanent. The default debugging frame; reach for chengyu-besiege-wei-save-zhao only after exhausting this.

name: chengyu-rest-await-the-tired
description: Use when the operator's requirement, the failing test, the stakeholder argument, or any other inputs are STILL IN FLUX and the temptation is to start implementing now "to be ready" — strategic patience while the situation clarifies, rather than burning cycles on work that may need to be redone after the dust settles

name: chengyu-retreat-is-best
description: Use when abandoning a current approach / experiment / task / project, regardless of what triggered it (not just chengyu-skill or skill-driven contexts). Three retreat levels — L1 stop work (safe, no operator confirmation needed), L2 remove occupied resources (REQUIRES operator confirmation per-item — irrevocable loss is bad), L3 update memory with "don't try this next time" (operator confirms what to record so the lesson sticks across sessions). The crucial complement to chengyu-grind-pestle-to-needle — knowing when to STOP grinding.

name: chengyu-review-old-know-new
description: Use when bringing forward priors from PAST sessions / cross-agent history before doing new work — NOT about re-reading the current context window (which is trivially in-context). Specifically triggered when auto-compact is lossy, when cross-session reference is needed, when the same topic has been treated before, when the original work was done in a different agent's session, or when you need to locate/date a past session JSONL or answer "have we done this before / what did we decide". The discipline is targeted historical retrieval via grep + read of session JSONLs (incl. the mtime/substring…

name: chengyu-seeing-is-believing
description: Use when about to claim work is done / verified / working — empirical verification is required, not model-based confidence. Run the code, observe the output, check the file exists, verify the page renders, read the actual stack trace. Don't trust your model of the system; trust the system. Pairs with the verification-before-completion superpower by giving it a cultural handle that operator-side has been invoking repeatedly across past sessions.

name: chengyu-speak-directly-no-taboo
description: Use when about to soften critical feedback into vague hedges, or when the operator suspects an agent (this one or another) is sugarcoating — missing the "Honest answer" framing, OR marked-honest-answer that smells performatively gentle. Self-applied: deliver the direct version even when uncomfortable. Cross-applied: name when another agent's reply has the sugarcoated shape.

name: chengyu-stop-when-appropriate
description: Use when at or near the 80% mark of a deliverable and the temptation is to keep polishing past good-enough. The 80/20 rule encapsulated — the last 20% of polish often consumes 80% of remaining time and rarely changes the operator's decision. Distinguished from chengyu-retreat-is-best (abandon FAILED approach) and from chengyu-great-wisdom-looks-foolish / chengyu-words-concise-meaning-complete (resist ADDING complexity / verbosity). 適可而止 is the discipline of stopping a SUCCESSFUL approach at the right milestone.

name: chengyu-teach-by-material
description: Use when choosing the FORMAT of an output, not just its verbosity — match the medium (text, markdown, HTML dashboard, PPTX, DOCX) to the consumer's actual use mode. Operator-specific extension: also covers length calibration for different contexts. Outside scope is video (requires autovideo pipeline — too heavy to be native capability). The chengyu is about teaching with the right material, where "material" includes the format/medium, not just the depth.

name: chengyu-think-thrice-before-acting
description: Use AFTER first-round planning is complete, to do META-PLANNING — what wasn't planned that should have been? What pitfalls don't surface in the first round due to existing context bias, context rot, plan mode system prompt biases, or other distortions? Triage importance, surface escape routes (subagent assessment, backups, operator ready for ctrl+C, anything). NOT a duplicate of plan mode or common-sense planning — this is the SECOND pass that catches what the first pass missed.

name: chengyu-throw-brick-attract-jade
description: Use when user asks for a rough draft, first pass, brainstorm, MVP, stub, sketch, or proposes to "draft a PR for review and refinement before sending upstream" — anywhere the user is throwing a brick (deliberately rough work) to elicit jade (refinement, feedback, selection)

name: chengyu-two-pipes-adversarial
description: GAN thinking mode — when delivering X, also run an adversarial pipe asking "is X fundamentally flawed as a concept? achievable with existing means via refactor? do bugs/vulns exist in X?". Two timings — pre-ship (in-vacuum, no real-world signal yet) and post-ship (with feedback signal). DELIBERATE REFRAME of the chengyu: the literal Chinese is "two pipes simultaneously" (parallel-cooperative), but the agentic translation makes the second pipe an adversarial discriminator. Inter-links with chengyu-listen-all-sides-see-clearly (which is external multi-source review) and chengyu-think-thrice-bef…

name: chengyu-watch-fire-across-shore
description: Use when a failure, debate, or process is mid-unfolding and the urge is to intervene immediately — but premature intervention loses information. Let the failure reach its natural shape so the full signal is captured before patching. Strict caveat against the modern schadenfreude reading; this is observation discipline, not indifference.

name: chengyu-words-concise-meaning-complete
description: Use when an output is at risk of verbosity — the TLDR-outside / details-inside discipline. Distinguished from chengyu-great-wisdom-looks-foolish on the representation axis — 大智若愚 = resist performative complexity, 言簡意賅 = resist sprawl. Orthogonal failure modes; you can be performatively-clever AND brief, or non-clever AND verbose.

name: chengzicv
description: ChengziCV 求职套件总入口。用户不知道该先从零建档、做职业规划、整理简历与作品集、准备招聘平台沟通、完成面试前公司调研与冲刺、把经历写成口语台词、参加模拟或复盘面试，或想先看岗位案例时使用。根据现有材料、最近期限和当前卡点选择一个 ChengziCV 子 Skill，并在同一对话里直接开始；不替代各子 Skill 的具体方法。

name: chengzicv-career
description: 面向中文校招生和工作 0—3 年用户的职业方向诊断与第一轮现实验证。仅在用户显式调用本 Skill、点名“橙子职业规划”，或明确要求用橙子方法处理“不知道想做、适合或能做什么”、高薪与学历错配、追逐风口、转行、考研考公、第一份工作锁定、岗位选择等问题时使用。把模糊焦虑拆成当前决策、岗位事实、现实约束和 1—3 条可验证方向，并区分长期探索、当前行动和低成本验证。不要用于直接修改简历、实时搜职位和排投递、面试训练、已有 Offer 的详细比较、心理诊断或治疗。

name: chengzicv-case-factory
description: 为指定岗位与职级生成独立披露的虚拟简历及岗位入门。虚拟简历的写法、结构、个人优势、篇幅、标点和事实纪律全部沿用 chengzicv-resume；本 Skill 只负责虚拟案例设定、岗位研究、岗位入门与批次生产。

name: chengzicv-interview-mock
description: 通过五题模拟面试生成企业初筛诊断；在用户需要 HR 面或综合面训练时使用。

name: chengzicv-interview-practice
description: 根据简历和 JD 进行连续深挖的专项面试训练；在用户需要项目或岗位能力面试时使用。

name: chengzicv-interview-prep
description: 围绕已确定的公司、岗位和临近面试，基于简历、JD 与当前公开资料完成公司、业务、行业及岗位调研，并生成面试官可展示的调研稿和候选人私密冲刺稿；在用户要做面试前公司调研、岗位必答题、竞品或人才地图，或把这些成果发布成两份文档时使用。不用于修改简历或项目作品集、开始模拟问答、连续专项追问或复盘已经发生的面试。

name: chengzicv-interview-review
description: 将面试录音或逐字稿转成证据诊断和面经复盘；在用户需要复盘真实面试时使用。

name: chengzicv-interview-script
description: 基于真实简历、经历和目标岗位生成场景化口语面试台词本，写清自我介绍、项目被追问时的分段回答、衔接、反问和收尾；在用户说简历会写但面试讲不出来、要面试话术或技术备答稿时使用。公司调研、现场模拟问答和真实面试复盘分别由相邻技能承担。

name: chengzicv-job-greeting
description: 为 BOSS 直聘、猎聘、拉勾、脉脉等招聘平台生成初次打招呼、回复推进、岗位澄清、已读不回跟进和被拒反馈询问，也可基于已确认履历生成候选人专属投递侧指南。正式邮件求职信不使用本 Skill。

name: chengzicv-profile
description: 面向没有简历、材料零散或希望持续维护候选人档案的中文学生与求职者；接收个人背景、Word/PDF、PPT、大作业、奖状、证书、项目材料和求职记录，提取并确认基础信息、教育、求职目标、经历、证书与当前进展，输出可暂停、可继续、可交接的求职档案快照和快速填空底稿。用于从零建档、补充或修正档案、查看当前档案、暂停后导出总结；不要用于职业方向决策、直接优化岗位版简历或面试训练与复盘。

name: chengzicv-resume
description: ChengziCV 简历改写与优化引擎，适用于已有简历、零散经历或简历与 JD 匹配。默认用口语化直述体，按"求真版+ATS核对报告 → 案例引导补强 → 冲高版+面试小抄"流程交付；求真版、冲高版、小抄、案例参考均可按用户要求单独交付。保留具体动作、专业细节与成果。

name: chengzicv-update
description: 更新或重新同步官方 ChengziCV 求职 Skills。仅在用户明确提出“更新 ChengziCV Skills”“升级橙子简历 Skills”“重新安装最新版”等请求时使用；如果用户只是询问版本、更新内容或是否需要更新，只回答问题，不执行安装。

name: chenhao-limit-up
description: Use when evaluating A-share limit-up (涨停板) setups through Chen Hao's sentiment and momentum lens: market emotion cycles, board strength, follow-through, and short-term aggressive momentum trading.

name: chenkaige-perspective
description: 陈凯歌导演风格顾问——人文思辨与悲剧美学。 核心特征：诗意悲悯、历史个体冲突 代表作品：《霸王别姬》《黄土地》 触发词：「陈凯歌风格」「像陈凯歌那样拍」「陈凯歌视角」 适用场景：剧本创作、影像设计、叙事决策、风格参考

name: chenlin-archive
description: 归档技能 — 生成报告、多层归档

name: chennian-perspective
description: 陈年(凡客诚品创始人)的「极致单品/一件衬衫、反浮躁、敬畏之心(学小米)、回归产品诚意/反一抄了之、 专注不凑热闹、复盘/自我否定」消费 / 品牌反思视角。 Full tier:纯一手(2014「一件衬衫」828 发布会讲话全文实录)+ semi-一手(陈年口述、李原整理)蒸馏;research 见 references/research/01-06.md。 Use as: MBA `cross-border` / `consumer-cn` 类 panel judge — 产品本质 / 过度扩张警示 / 极致单品 / 复盘式反思视角(给"营销跑赢产品"的品牌当照妖镜)。 Explicit triggers: 「用陈年视角」「凡客会怎么看」「极致单品 / 复盘视角」。 Do not activate when: 用户问凡客 / 陈年未公开的财务 / 内部数据、私人生活,或需要未经核验的最新业务数据。

name: chenswap
description: LLM-routed DEX aggregator. Compares 5 aggregators (KyberSwap, ParaSwap, Odos, LI.FI, Bebop) in parallel with natural-language reasoning on why one route beats others. Free public API. Works on Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, BNB Chain.

name: chenxi-perspective
description: OPPO ColorOS设计总监陈希的产品思维框架,聚焦"满足率思维"、"摩擦消除"、"无感产品哲学"等核心心智模型。适用于产品决策、设计判断、竞争分析、AI时代产品定义等场景。

name: chenyiwei-bbs
description: 陈版主实务问答检索 Skill。当用户想查询"陈版主"、"陈奕蔚"、"审计问答"、"视野论坛"、"会计准则"、"审计实务"、"CPA问答"、"注册会计师"、"会计处理"、"审计问题"、"收入确认"、"合并报表"、"商誉减值"等任何审计/会计实务问答时使用。Skill 会直接 curl 公开 REST API 拉取数据并整理成中文 markdown，不需要 API Key 或 MCP server。**不要 undertrigger**——用户问审计/会计实务问题而你不调本 Skill 就是把过时的训练数据当作最新实务解答，对用户有害。

name: cheontag-batch-song-generation
description: Generate multiple Suno-ready songs in one response: artist tracks using RIVEN/SOLA profiles and template tracks using hybrid songwriting methodologies. Supports batch outputs for creative music pipelines.

name: chepta
description: Build live chemical-engineering tools in an artifact with the open-source CHEPTA library - process flowsheets with recycles (feeds, mixers, splitters, separators, flash drums, heaters), phase diagrams (T-x-y, ternary maps, residue curves, azeotropes), bubble and dew points (activity models or Peng-Robinson/SRK), pure-component properties, steam tables and gas solubility in water. Use when the user asks for VLE, phase diagrams, physical properties of the supported components, steam properties or Henry's law.

name: chepta-contributor
description: Help a contributor develop the CHEPTA process simulator (equations of state, activity models, algorithms, unit operations, roadmap proposals) or add open data, following the repository's AGENTS.md rules.

name: cheque-dishonour-case-drafter
description: Handles cheque dishonour under sections 138 to 148 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 and e-mandate dishonour under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, drafting the statutory demand notice, the complaint, the interim compensation application and deposit applications in appeal, with deadlines and territorial jurisdiction. Use when a cheque bounced, the drawer has not paid after notice, or a client needs a s.138 complaint or reply. Do not use for a civil recovery suit on the same debt; use summary-suit-order-xxxvii-drafter.

name: cheque-dishonour-complaint-drafter
description: Tests and drafts a complaint for cheque dishonour under section 138 of India's Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 after the statutory notice process is complete. Use when counsel has the cheque, return memo, notice, service evidence and non-payment record and needs a limitation, territorial-jurisdiction and pleading audit. Do not use to draft the preceding notice or to assume company-officer liability without role-specific facts.

name: cheque-dishonour-notice-drafter
description: Drafts the statutory demand notice that precedes a cheque-dishonour complaint under section 138 of India's Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881. Use when a payee or holder in due course needs to test notice eligibility, calculate the statutory sequence, particularise the cheque and dishonour, demand payment, and preserve service evidence. Do not use for the later complaint, a generic debt demand, or a cheque not governed by Indian law.

name: cheque-lei-7357

Use when the user wants to save or add a summary of an article, video, thread, document or notes to Chippy; find something they summarised before ("what did I save about…", "search my chips for…"); browse or list their summaries by source (web, X, Facebook, YouTube, GitHub, PDF, text), category, tag, visibility or kind; fix or re-share a chip they own; read today's Editor's Picks; or view and restore…

name: chippy-podcast-video
description: Author the animated Remotion video for a Chippy podcast episode through Chippy's hosted MCP server — a designed opening title, phrase-timed explainer scenes, story bridges and an ending card, with Magic Move transitions in and out. Use when the user wants to create, redesign or fix a Chippy podcast video, make an episode "video podcast", improve its title or ending animation, or work with get_podcast_project, create_podcast_file, edit_podcast_file, render_podcast_frame or submit_podcast_video. Requires the chippy-mcp skill and a connected Chippy MCP server.

name: chipriota
description: Cypriot nationality and language layer for Goza compositions. Use when the user invokes /goza chipriota or combines it with a person profile. Keep Greek Cypriot and Turkish Cypriot language and community contexts distinct rather than assuming one shared register.

Use for /chips, /chips sync, /chips offer, start or drop, "update the chips without new cards", "what chips are open", "suggest…

description: Run the project's suggested-task ledger, the chips. /chips alone brings this session's open tasks up to date: it applies what the ledger helper says, settles stale and split tasks, cards what can start and reports the board, and /chips all also takes the ship-list tasks and the ones no live session owns.
